title: Cosine Similarity and Ranking

learning_objectives: Explain vector geometry and neighborhood results in plain language and connect it to src/main_cosine_similarity.py.
Trace one input through the cosine similarity and ranking stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the cosine similarity and ranking stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for vector geometry and neighborhood results.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
